title: On the Difficulty of Token-Level Modeling of Dysfluency and Fluency Shaping Artifacts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance disparities by measuring Word Error Rate (WER) and token-level error rates on atypical speech patterns (stuttered, dysfluent, and fluency-shaped speech) compared to standard fluent speech using the LibriStutter and Kassel State of Fluency (KSoF) datasets.

Conducting a 'Tokenization Bias Analysis' to quantify English-centric biases in the model's tokenizer by calculating Tokenization Error Rate (TER) and Token Overestimation Percentage (TOP), specifically measuring the over-fragmentation of German words and dysfluency markers compared to English.
